original_tile.description: A large storage vase with a decorative slip. The style hints that it was fired in the home-kiln of a canyon dweller.

shape_reuse.reason: Native Wine Vase inherits Vase and uses exactly the same Items/sw_jug.bmp mask; no new silhouette, handle, band or exterior state is declared.

palette.rule: Wine Vase removes RandomColors. Slip remains decorative, not a visible pool of wine or liquid-driven glass band.

native_behavior.scope: Inherited opaque pottery/storage behavior stays native; wine content is hidden by the complete wall. No liquid simulation or invented exterior state.

donor_reference.role: Actual Urn.png supplies restrained pottery shading and open-rim/edge convention only. Keep the Qud long neck, pair of handles and two slip bands.

view_contract.production: One original fixed map view: both symmetric handles connect neck to shoulder; two slip bands remain on bowl; visible open rim.
view_contract.diagnostic: Angled actual model shows hollow mouth, handle depth and continuation of both decorative rings.
view_contract.scale: One16x24 source cell ->512x768 manual ->256square recipient. Anchor8,16; no alpha-bound sizing.

actual_new_generation: None. Reuse unchanged accepted complete Blender surface and material masks, then apply exact native w/m palette.
